$comment: Play crash clusters this repo has already diagnosed, keyed by the issue id in the console URL.
Archiving an issue in the Play Console hides it there; it does NOT stop the API returning it,
and the Reporting API has no write method to archive with (verified 2026-08-29 against the
v1beta1 discovery document - every POST it offers is a `:query`). So the acknowledgement lives
here, in the repo, beside the reasoning.
`fixedInVersionCode` is the FIRST build carrying the fix. An issue reappearing at or above that
code is NOT known - it is a regression, and `vitals.mjs` says so loudly. Muting by id alone
would silence exactly the report that matters.
A record with `"kind": "PLATFORM"` is a defect in Android or the WebView with NO Canari frame,
which no change here can fix. It is not a mute: it stays PLATFORM only while three facts hold -
no report carries an app frame, no report names a WebView major newer than `webViewMajors`, and no
versionCode newer than `baseline.versionCode` reports it above `baseline.per1kUsers` (with Play
withholding the user count, ANY report on a newer versionCode re-opens it). One broken fact and
`vitals.mjs` reports it as NEW, with the reason. The rules are `judgePlatform` in classify.mjs.

e2054d3a3a5e20908789ffd5e3ccdd47.diagnosis: Excluding com.google.android.material also dropped androidx.coordinatorlayout, which no Kotlin file names and which the biometric plugin's auth_activity.xml inflates as its root view. Every biometric call died in the inflater.
e2054d3a3a5e20908789ffd5e3ccdd47.note: Diagnosed independently on a Pixel 6a on 2026-08-28 before Play surfaced it; the Play report on versionCode 14005 is the same defect seen in the field. Production carried 14011, which PREDATES the fix.

7bea93777c2eb50d5aa34cb55a62350f.location: a binder thread: the audio service asked a player to pause after its AAudio stream was destroyed
7bea93777c2eb50d5aa34cb55a62350f.diagnosis: A use-after-free inside Android's libaaudio_internal: AudioService paused (BnPlayer::onTransact -> PlayerBase::trackPause) a player whose AAudio stream had already been closed, so its mutex was destroyed. No frame is Canari's, wry's or Tauri's. At v1.1.1, where it first appeared, the app opened no audio stream itself (calls shipped in v1.5.0), so the only AAudio client in the process was the Chromium WebView.
frames: #07 /system/lib64/libaudioclient.so (android::media::BnPlayer::onTransact(unsigned int, android::Parcel const&, android::Parcel*, unsigned int)+1164)
7bea93777c2eb50d5aa34cb55a62350f.webViewNote: Neither the report nor the Reporting API carries a WebView version for a native crash; the set is empty, so the first report that names one re-opens the issue.

baseline.denominatorNote: Play withholds crashRateMetricSet distinctUsers per versionCode (too few users) and the Reporting API has no session count, so the baseline rate is unmeasured.

7bea93777c2eb50d5aa34cb55a62350f.note: One report, 2026-10-07. Classified PLATFORM rather than muted: tools/play-vitals/README.md#platform-issues.
